Adding 1 to both sides gives $a_{n+1} + 1 = 2(a_n + 1)$, so $b_n = a_n + 1$ is geometric with ratio 2 and $b_1 = 4$.

Thus $b_n = 2^{n+1}$ and $a_n = 2^{n+1} - 1$. In particular $a_{10} = 2^{11} - 1 = 2047$.
